headline: Two shipped AI integrations, measured in the open.
ledeMetrics: RECEIPTS ANALYZER — 14 DAYS (5 PLANNING, 9 BUILDING) · TASK2CHECK — IELTS FEEDBACK

hero.alt: The Receipts Analyzer dashboard for the last 6 months: 18,75 € total spent and 3,76 € average monthly spending, above a per-product spending breakdown with percentage bars.

problem: Two personal problems worth solving properly: a family needed visibility into purchase frequency and spend across time ranges without manual data entry, and IELTS candidates need Writing Part 2 feedback that is specific, fast, and repeatable.
constraint: Self-directed and solo: 5 days of planning, 9 of building for the Receipts Analyzer. Working style stated plainly — architecture, prompt engineering, and product decisions are mine; implementation is AI-assisted. Neither overstated as hand-coding nor undersold as "AI wrote it."
decision: Receipts Analyzer: OpenAI API for extraction instead of OCR — messy receipts yield structured line items directly, at the cost of an accuracy loop that has to be measured rather than assumed. Task2Check: prompt-engineered IELTS Writing Part 2 feedback against the band criteria, deliberately shipped without an auth system — scoped to exactly the job it does. Both on React Router 7 (framework mode) + TypeScript.

figures.alt: The receipt review screen: store name and address, transaction date, and total paid, all editable above the extracted line-item table before it's saved.
Task2Check's Task Response band score with feedback and a concrete sentence-level rewrite, beside the original IELTS prompt and essay response it was scored against.

evidence.caption: Both surfaces make the AI's output checkable rather than final: receipts land in an editable review step before anything saves, and Task2Check scores each criterion separately with its reasoning shown, not just a number.

result.label: STATUS — ITERATING
result.body: Extraction accuracy is still being refined — every receipt goes through the review step above before it's trusted. This record is presented as active iteration, not a finished claim: evidence of direction in AI integration, deliberately distinct from production AI experience.
